title: Event
description: An event. Class-level properties describe the event type/category. Instance-level properties describe a concrete occurrence logged during a run.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this event belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent involved, if any.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when the event occurred.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the event record format.

target_instance_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the object instance involved, if any.

metadata.description: [instance-level] Additional structured data associated with the event.

examples.description: The coconut began to move after being touched.
